votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of April 8, 2025; May 13, 2025; May 20, 2025; and July 8, 2025.
votes.description: The Board approved the official meeting minutes from four prior CRA meetings held earlier in 2025.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda, including setting the date of Tuesday, October 14, 2025 at 2 p.m. to accept public comment and consider adopting a resolution to amend the CRA FY2025-26 budget (Budget Amendment No. 1).
votes.description: The Board approved the consent agenda, which set a public hearing date for the CRA's first budget amendment of FY2025-26, consolidating funding sources into the Disaster Relief Loan Program and Commercial Development Loan Program among other items.
